- [USER] User asked for advice on measuring the success of digital marketing efforts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Website traffic: Measure the number of visitors to a website.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Conversion rate: Measure the percentage of visitors who take specific actions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Engagement rate: Measure likes, shares, and comments on social media posts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cost-per-click
